step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: Determine if the referred training information is displayed on the Project tab:
When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 36 - Special benefits on Fishing claims or other complex claim conditions .
Remarks Line 2: Type “CT [XX], REN WK [XXXX], APW [XXXX], PSW [XXXX], ENT WKS [XX], SEX [XX], SCI 99 (if applicable for extended parental benefits).” Note
Remarks Line 3: If applicable, type “[NO-CR]”, [claimant’s report information], [MA rescind information], or [D3 termination information].”
Remarks Line 4: Enter the appropriate information.
Remarks Line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 36 - Special benefits on Fishing claims or other complex claim conditions .
Remarks Line 2: Type “CT [XX], REN WK [XXXX], APW [XXXX], PSW [XXXX], ENT WKS [XX], SEX [XX], SCI 99 (if applicable for extended parental benefits).”
Remarks Line 3: If applicable, type “[NO-CR]”, [claimant’s report information], [MA rescind information], or [D3 termination information].”

Remarks Line 4: Type “T171 — — STRT-WK/DY [the course start w/c], END-WK-DY [the course end w/c], PROJ-HRRC [the Responsibility Centre code or institution code, if applicable], PROJ-NO [the 10-digit agreement number; use preceding zeros if the number is less than 10 digits], TRAIN-ID [the training ID code], BREAK START/END WK [the w/c code, of any break weeks].”

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: Determine if any of the following decisions must be communicated to the client:

ul.li: There is an allocation of earnings.

A disentitlement is being imposed.
If yes, go to step 40.
If no, go to step 41.

step.cmd: In ACS, create and save or add details to the saved N-00-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: If an antedate has been denied, select Antedate denied or postdate Message - Initial/renewal/continuing claim (2481) .
Special benefits approved (3046): Select Maternity and/or parental benefits (standard/extended) approved or denied with sickness options (3054) .
If there is an allocation, select Allocation of Earnings (2516) .

step.cmd: Determine if Level 2 adjudication is required:

ul.li: If yes, in NWS, create a client Note and type “Send the N-00-00-00 letter.” Go to step 42.
If no, send the saved N-00-00-00 letter and go to step 43.

step.cmd: In NWS, reassign any CR WI for the contentious issue to Level 2 as follows:

ul.li: Destination — SCC: Select the SCC as shown in FTS.
Details: Type “Unable to complete at Level 1.”

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the CR Conversion WI.
